title: Bound on maxima under pointwise slack
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers and let $p,q: br	o br$ be functions on the natural numbers. If $p(a)\le q(a)+1$ for every $a$ in $l$, then the maximum of the values $p(a)$ over $a$ in $l$, taken to be $0$ when $l$ is empty, is at most one plus the corresponding maximum of the values $q(a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of natural numbers
$p,q$ map natural numbers to natural numbers
